# T14 self-hosted dependencies

Tabler Core 1.4.0 / MIT, official npm @tabler/core (Bootstrap 5.3.7 CSS included). Only dist/css/tabler.min.css; no plugins or JS. Copyright banners preserved. The npm archive omits its top-level LICENSE; included LICENSE retrieved from https://github.com/tabler/tabler/blob/dev/LICENSE on 2026-10-30 (2018–2026); artifact banner retains 2018–2025.

Tabler Icons Webfont 3.50.0 / MIT, official npm @tabler/icons-webfont. Original CSS and referenced WOFF2 font subsets only; LICENSE copied verbatim from archive. https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons

Both archives verified against npm dist.integrity SHA512 before extraction. No CDN or remote font runtime dependency. CSS sourceMappingURL comments point to optional development maps not shipped.

Bundled Bootstrap 5.3.7 MIT LICENSE copied verbatim from official npm bootstrap-5.3.7.tgz (package/LICENSE), included as BOOTSTRAP-LICENSE. No Bootstrap package runtime files added separately.
